content: Evaluation Metrics. To evaluate the strategy formulation ability, we introduce a measure called Coverage( INLINEFORM0 ), defined as the fraction of total query data instances, for which LiLi has successfully formulated strategies that lead to winning. If LiLi wins on all episodes for a given dataset, INLINEFORM1 is 1.0. To evaluate the predictive performance, we use Avg. MCC and avg. +ve F1 score.
